retention_tricks: Rapid Cuts/Pacing: Keep visuals changing every 1-3 seconds.
On-Screen Text: Reinforce spoken words or add extra info.
Sound Design: Use trendy sounds, sound effects, and engaging music.
Visual Intrigue: Use unexpected visuals, satisfying loops, or quick reveals.
Direct Address/Eye Contact: Speak directly to the camera, creating a personal connection.
Open Loops: Hint at information coming later in the video or series.
